{{See also|Horseman's Candle}} {{Infobox/Item |id = REPELLING_CANDLE |image = *Repelling Candle |slot = *Repelling Candle |rarity = Uncommon |collection = Acacia Log VII |lore = Prevents unwanted monsters from spawning on your island!

{{Pink|Emits life-scarring aroma!}} |raw_materials = *960 Acacia Log *160 Coal |mat_cost_bazaar = *1 Enchanted Coal *6 Enchanted Acacia Log }} The '''Repelling Candle''' is an {{Uncommon}} item that can be used to prevent [[Mobs]] from spawning on the player's {{zone|Private Island}}. The crafting recipe for this item is unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Acacia Log|VII}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Acacia Log VII}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Coal |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |B2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |C2 = Enchanted Acacia Log |A3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |B3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |C3 = Enchanted Acacia Log |Output = Repelling Candle }} }} == Usage == When the '''Repelling Candle''' is unlocked in the Island Properties menu, [[Mobs|monsters]] can be prevented from spawning on the island. Mobs spawned from minions are unaffected by this item. It is very useful if the player wishes to cull mobs but also leave the island's biome unaltered, as previous solutions would often use a {{Item|Nether Biome Stick}} to make the hostile mobs into {{MobSprite|Chicken}}s. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Chat Messages == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Message |- |class="ct" | Placed on {{Zone|The Garden}} |{{Dialogue|&cYou can't place that here! Everyone is friendly!}} |} == Gallery == Repelling Candle Render.png|A placed '''Repelling Candle''' Repelling Candle Minikloon.png|As seen when placed by {{RN|a|rank=false|size=10|Minikloon}} Repelling Candle in the Hub.png|A Repelling Candle placed in the Hub === Colors === Red Repelling Candle.png|Red Orange Repelling Candle.png|Orange Yellow Repelling Candle.png|Yellow Green Repelling Candle.png|Green Blue Repelling Candle.png|Blue Purple Repelling Candle.png|Purple Black Repelling Candle.png|Black Pink Repelling Candle.png|Pink Lilac Repelling Candle.png|Lilac Aqua Repelling Candle.png|Aqua Cyan Repelling Candle.png|Cyan Brown Repelling Candle.png|Brown Gray Repelling Candle.png|Gray White Repelling Candle.png|White == Trivia == *There appears to be a {{red|Red}} Repelling Candle in {{zone|Catacombs Entrance}} in the {{zone|Coal Mine}}. *There is a bug where the Repelling Candle is able to be placed in the Hub. The bug happens if the player clicks on a crafting table with the Repelling Candle in their hand. *A visual of the candle's sphere can be seen by using mods such as NotEnoughUpdates. The commands to see it are: **/neuzeesphere on **/neuzeesphere 50 (or 10) **/neuzeesphere setcenter - moves center of sphere to current location, so stand on the candle **/neuzeesphere off - to remove the sphere *Unlike most other related blocks, it can still be placed after the 0.19.9 update, but it can also be used from the Island Properties menu without placing. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.7.9|[[File:Repelling Candle.png|26px]] Added '''Repelling Candle'''.}} {{History|0.9.5|Fixed bugs when placing or breaking '''Repelling Candles'''.}} {{History|2021/Nov 8|'''Repelling Candles''' can no longer be placed on some blocks in the [[Hub Island|Hub]].}} {{History|0.19.3|'''Repelling Candle''' now requires {{Coll|Acacia Log VI}} to craft instead of IX.}} {{History|0.19.9|Changed '''Repelling Candle''' from a placed block to a [[Settings]] feature.}} {{History|0.23|'''Repelling Candle''' now requires {{Coll|Acacia Log VII}} to craft instead of VI.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Acacia Log}} [[Category:Blocks]] [[Category:Items]]
